# Debugging checklist

- [ ] Section `1. Purpose and scope` addressed with project evidence
- [ ] Section `2. Normative sources (high confidence)` addressed with project evidence
- [ ] Section `3. Method — reproduce, isolate, root-cause` addressed with project evidence
- [ ] Section `4. Fix and prevention rules` addressed with project evidence
- [ ] Section `5. Release gates (blocking)` addressed with project evidence
- [ ] Section `6. Verification of this skill (Phase 4 gate)` addressed with project evidence
- [ ] Assumptions, evidence links, and open questions recorded
- [ ] No normative text copied from standards; citations are number/edition/clause only
- [ ] Traceability links to related artifacts recorded (or N/A with reason)
